global_warning: These are bounded internal experiments, not independent replication and not evidence of consciousness or unrestricted general intelligence. Open each evidence file for its exact protocol and scope.

claims.title: Concepts, skills, and transfer
claims.headline: 20/20 held-out transfer; 1,230.59× experienced-vs-blank advantage
claims.scope: Synthetic pixel worlds with anonymous actions. Not arbitrary natural environments.

claims.title: Autonomous concept-count selection
claims.headline: Five event concepts selected; 20/20 transfer; 498.06× advantage
claims.scope: Structured rendered events; the changed-pixel and clustering biases remain engineered.

claims.title: Real-file data rescue
claims.headline: 5/5 unfamiliar JSONL files repaired; 348× experience advantage
metrics: Validator used only for scalar feedback
claims.scope: A bounded JSONL repair family, not arbitrary office work.

claims.title: Learning-to-learn
claims.headline: Median 2.30× and mean 4.48× held-out speedup across five minds
metrics: Four of five improved; one regressed to 0.90×
claims.scope: A learned three-number acquisition policy within the tested task distribution.

claims.title: Grounded words and clarification
claims.headline: 45/45 successful trials; 30/30 ambiguous references resolved
metrics: Six words induced from pixels, utterances, and pointing
Unknown word refused instead of guessed
claims.scope: Colors and simple shapes in a fixed approach-action family.

claims.title: Two-rocket Asteroids coordination
claims.headline: 350 hits with both agents active in 8/8 runs
metrics: Communication ablation: 311 hits and one life lost
claims.scope: A purpose-built two-agent Asteroids test, not open-ended cooperation.

claims.title: Photo → glyph → word composition
claims.headline: Apple reached 96%; overall composed accuracy was 53.22%
claims.scope: A valuable mixed result. The precommitted overall claim failed.
